versions.changelog: v1.3.1: core planter only; --i-trust-stack; allowlisted stack tools; catalog local-only (opt-in --anchor-external); no skip-verify/force; retrieve consent.
v1.3.0 SkillSpector harden: declare permissions; remove --skip-verify and --force; retrieve requires --i-consent; clarify no auto-publish (surfaces are local prep only).

- Added support for "Champion Kernel Eggs", enabling planting and verification of sealed council personas.
- New script: plant_champion_council.py for champion egg operations.
- Reference added for LYGO_KERNEL_EGGS.
- Updated documentation to version 1.2.0, describing champion eggs features and new registry/army workflows.
- Metadata updated: now includes "champion_egg" capability.

lygo-kernel-egg-planter v1.0.1 — Adds tamper-proof egg verification and mandates bulletproof workflow.

- Introduces preflight and mandatory post-plant egg verification; retrieval is blocked if verification fails (QUARANTINE state).
- New scripts: preflight, smoke test, and egg verification; reorganized workflow.
- Tamper-proofing via SHA-256, Merkle registry, and lattice gate (see new four pillars docs).
- Consent rules tightened—including explicit agent contract and pillar summary requirements.
- Updated and expanded documentation for the new pipeline and agent mandates.

- Initial release of lygo-kernel-egg-planter for voluntary, consent-based anchoring and publishing of kernel/protocol eggs (≤100 KiB) on public, legal surfaces.
- Explicit opt-in required for every plant operation; no auto-publish or tracking behavior.
- Supports planting verifiable manifests (eggs) for P0 kernel, protocol drivers, firmware, and ClawHub catalog.
- Integrates with lygo-protocol-stack-operator, book-brain, and lygo-mint-verifier for end-to-end proof and retrieval workflows.
- Multiple surfaces supported: local storage, Arweave Turbo, GitHub Pages, and human-pushed HF datasets.
- Includes detailed consent and ethics guidelines to ensure user control and transparency.
